extDesc.message: Finds the videos on any page and saves them in one click.

emptyBody.message: Play the video or refresh the page. Hudhud wakes up the moment it spots one.

emptyTip.message: DRM-protected videos (Netflix and the like) can’t be downloaded.

scanning.message: Scanning… this can take up to a minute

notWebPage.message: Hudhud only works on web pages

playlistInfoTitle.message: This video is part of a playlist

playlistInfoBody.message: Download just this one, or the whole list at once.

fileNameHint.message: Leave empty to use the video title

drmBlocked.message: This video is DRM-protected and can’t be downloaded

mergeNote.message: Video and audio will be merged into one MP4.

tsNote.message: Will be saved as TS (MP4 conversion is off in settings).

liveNote.message: This is a live stream: it records until you cancel or it ends.

helperBody.message: A small app on your computer that downloads in high quality and merges video and audio. Setup takes a minute.

helperStep2.message: 2. Wait for it to finish (about a minute)

supportBody.message: If it helps, chip in so we can keep it free forever.

updateBody.message: Download it and run the installer. After that you can update from here in one click.

updateBodyManaged.message: Takes under a minute. Your settings and downloads stay.

updateMoveBody.message: For one-click updates: remove Hudhud on the extensions page and load it again from this folder (only once).

moveBody.message: Remove Hudhud on the extensions page and load it again from this folder. Only once.

updateBusy.message: Wait for the downloads to finish, then update.

updateNotManaged.message: This copy isn’t installed from the Hudhud folder. Download the update and run the installer.

errGone.message: This video is gone. Refresh the page.

errContextNeedsHelper.message: Needs the helper (run $1). Or play the video and use the Hudhud icon.

errNoSpace.message: This video is about $1, but only $2 is free on this disk. Free up some space or pick a lower quality.

errSignIn.message: The site wants you to sign in. Open it in your browser, sign in, then try again.

errAge.message: This video is age-restricted. Sign in to the site in your browser, then try again.

errPrivate.message: This video is private. Only its owner can watch it.

errMembers.message: This video is for channel members only. If you’re a member, sign in in your browser and try again.

errGeo.message: This video isn’t available in your country.

errUnavailable.message: This video was removed or is no longer available.

errLiveNotStarted.message: The live stream hasn’t started yet. Try again once it does.

errDrm.message: This video is DRM-protected and can’t be downloaded.

errNeedDeno.message: YouTube needs a part of the helper that’s missing. Run $1 again.

errUpdateYtdlp.message: The site changed. Update yt-dlp in Settings → Helper, then try again.

errUnsupported.message: The helper doesn’t support this site. Play the video and download it from the Hudhud icon.

errToolMissing.message: Part of the helper is missing. Run $1 again.

errForbidden.message: The site refused the download. Refresh the page and try again, or use the helper.

errTooMany.message: The site is seeing too many downloads. Wait a few minutes and try again.

errServer.message: The site is having trouble right now. Try again later.

errNetwork.message: The connection dropped or the site isn’t responding. Check your internet and try again.

errDiskFull.message: There’s not enough disk space. Free some up and try again.

errAccess.message: Can’t save to this folder. Pick another one in Settings.

errNameLong.message: The file name is too long. Lower “Maximum name length” in Settings.

errBlocked.message: Your browser or antivirus blocked the file.

errFileFailed.message: The file couldn’t be saved. Check your downloads folder and try again.

errBrowserClosed.message: The browser closed before the download finished. Try again.

errUnknown.message: Something unexpected went wrong. Try again, and if it keeps happening press “Report a problem”.

nativeForbidden.message: The helper doesn’t allow this extension (wrong extension ID during install)

nativeLost.message: Lost the helper connection (the file may still have finished in the folder)

hlsLive.message: This is a live stream; record it with the helper

hlsAudioUnsupported.message: The separate audio uses a format the browser can’t handle; use the helper

remuxFailed.message: MP4 conversion failed ($1); use the helper

ctxPage.message: Download this page’s video with Hudhud

saveDesc.message: All downloads go here, optionally sorted into a folder per site.

optSubdirHint.message: For example Hudhud. Leave empty to save straight to Downloads.

helperDesc.message: A small app on your computer that handles YouTube and tricky sites, and merges video with audio.

optRateHint.message: Like 2M or 500K. Leave empty for no limit.

optEmbedMetaHint.message: Title, channel and date inside the MP4

browserDesc.message: For videos Hudhud downloads without the helper.

optHlsHint.message: Runs right in the browser, no apps needed

optHistory.message: Keep downloads in the browser history

optRulesHint.message: Advanced: a different pattern and folder per site.

aboutTitle.message: Hudhud is free and open source

aboutBody.message: If it saves you time, chip in any amount via InstaPay.

updateFound.message: Version $1 is out. Open Hudhud and press “Update”.

diagCopied.message: Copied ✓ Paste it into your GitHub report

diagHint.message: Extension, helper, browser and OS versions and the last error. No links or file names.

ruleReplace.message: "replace" in rule $1 must be an array

pathAbsolute.message: The folder must be a full path, like /home/me/Videos or C:\Videos

helperNotInstalled.message: Not installed. Run $1 from the helper download.

welcomeSub.message: Three quick steps and Hudhud is ready to find any video on any page.

step1Title.message: Pin the icon next to the address bar

step1Body.message: Click the puzzle icon in your browser and pin Hudhud, so you can watch the crest rise.

step2Title.message: Install the helper (optional, needed for YouTube)

step2Body.message: A small app that downloads in top quality and merges video and audio. Open $1 and wait a minute.

step3Body.message: Open any video and click the hoopoe. Crest up means it found something.

legalNote.message: Hudhud is just a tool. You’re responsible for what you download, and for respecting its owners’ rights and each site’s terms.
